items.difficulty_reason: The retained proof is self-contained algebra: ML condition via Lemma ML-local, replacement of the system by the images E_n with surjective transitions, identification of H^i_m(M) with lim E_n, then the descending chain condition (Lemma descending-chain) to bound the number of nontrivial kernels and conclude eventual isomorphism. Retained author proof at lines 912-924.
